headline: Asia Consolidated DMC Pte. Ltd files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Asia Consolidated DMC Pte. Ltd, a Singapore-registered entity, has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition in Yatra Online Limited. The filing marks the formal initiation of the takeover process under Indian securities law.
detail: Asia Consolidated DMC Pte. Ltd, incorporated in Singapore, has submitted a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This disclosure is triggered when a person acquires shares or voting rights in a listed company such that the aggregate holding crosses 25% of the paid-up capital or voting rights, or when an acquirer intends to acquire such a threshold. The filing initiates the statutory timeline for Yatra Online's board to form an independent committee, evaluate the offer terms, and for the acquirer to launch a mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders.
